# GitHub handle to Zulip user ID mapping
#
# This file maps GitHub usernames to Zulip user IDs for PR notifications.
# When a user opens a PR, they will receive a private Zulip message if they
# are listed in this file.
#
# Format: github_handle,zulip_user_id
# One mapping per line. Lines starting with # are comments.
#
# To find your Zulip user ID:
# 1. Visit your profile in Zulip web interface (https://debezium.zulipchat.com)
# 2. Click on your profile picture/name in the top right
# 3. Click "Profile" in the dropdown menu
# 4. The user ID is shown in the profile details (or in the URL)
#
# Alternatively, use the Zulip API:
# curl -X GET https://debezium.zulipchat.com/api/v1/users \
#   -u BOT_EMAIL:BOT_API_KEY
#
# To add yourself to this list, submit a PR with your GitHub handle and Zulip user ID.
#
# Example entries:
# username1,12345
# username2,67890
#
# Add your mapping below:
